executive_summary: Acme Portal was assessed for external web application vulnerabilities. Two findings were identified, the most critical being SQL injection in the login form.
executive_recommendations: Migrate all SQL statements to parameterized queries.
Enable a Content Security Policy across the portal.

findings.description: The login form is vulnerable to SQL injection via the username parameter.
findings.evidenceText: Server returned a database error with injected content.
findings.evidenceCodeBlock: Error: syntax error at or near 'OR 1=1'

findings.description: Responses do not include a Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.impact: Increased risk of client-side attacks such as XSS.
findings.evidenceText: No Content-Security-Policy header present in response.
